definitions.explanation: The sixth month of the year. Known as the rainy season (梅雨, tsuyu) in most of Japan.

examples.japanese: {六月|ろくがつ}は{雨|あめ}が{多|おお}いです。
examples.english: There's a lot of rain in June.

examples.japanese: {六月|ろくがつ}に{梅雨|つゆ}が{始|はじ}まります。
examples.english: The rainy season starts in June.

examples.japanese: {六月|ろくがつ}は{結婚式|けっこんしき}が{多|おお}いです。
examples.english: There are many weddings in June.
examples.notes: June bride tradition from the West

notes: June is literally 'month six.' Most of Japan (except Hokkaido) experiences the rainy season (梅雨, tsuyu) in June. Despite the rain, 'June bride' (ジューンブライド) is popular due to Western influence.
